remarks: Build your dream home at 6316 McKinley Parkway! This mostly cleared, half-acre building lot offers the rare combination of scenic views, convenient utilities and an outstanding Hamburg location. Enjoy unobstructed views stretching for miles over the neighboring patio homes toward the beautiful Boston Hills. Water and natural gas are available at the curb, ready for connection by the builder, and the Village of Hamburg sewer system ends at the southwest corner of the property, eliminating the need for a septic system. Located just steps from the Village of Hamburg, you can enjoy easy access to restaurants, shops, parks, schools and community events—all without Village taxes. Commuters will appreciate being approximately five minutes from Route 219 and eight minutes from the New York State Thruway, providing convenient access to Buffalo and the surrounding Southtowns. A ready-to-build lot with utilities, remarkable views and a highly desirable location—bring your plans and make this property your own!
